$schema_note: v2 reference for the basal population-phenotype report card. Axes carry presentation + a TYPED criterion. Population-stat axes grade by Welch t-test of candidate per-cell values vs these blessed reference values (cell-level n). A SIGNIFICANT difference (p<p_min) is drift/mismatch. Self-pin => p=1.0 at baseline; future drift / PDMP lowers p. Judgement is deferred: the pin is current main's behavior, not a biological target.
title: Basal-condition population phenotype — v1↔v2 equivalence

stimulus.ensemble: 8 seeds x 16 gens; vEcoli master; fresh ParCa; gen-lb 3

findings: EQUIVALENCE reference: v2ecoli graded against a vEcoli v1 ensemble (not a self-pin). Welch t-test of v2 cell-level values vs v1 ref_values; r2 for omics; flux_scatter for the exchange fingerprint.
v1<->v2 share cistron/monomer/flux ordering exactly — vectors align positionally (no ID remapping). Ribosome 30S/50S sliced from v1's positional bulk by index (s30/s50 from v1 sim_data).
v1 values read by scripts/pin_vecoli_equivalence_reference.py (self-contained cross-impl reader; shared analysis_runner is untouched).
tolerance bands inherited from the self-pin template; revisit per-axis equivalence margins (delta) — and consider TOST for the formal claim.

physiology.doubling_time.label: Doubling time
physiology.doubling_time.how: Cell-cycle time over confirmed divisions (one value per divided cell). Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.cell_mass.label: Cell mass
physiology.cell_mass.how: Time-mean total cell mass (listeners__mass__cell_mass), one value/cell. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.cell_volume.label: Cell volume
physiology.cell_volume.how: Time-mean cell volume (listeners__mass__volume), one value/cell. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.oric.label: Replication origins (oriC)
physiology.oric.how: Time-mean number_of_oric — >1 indicates overlapping replication rounds. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.replication_initiation.label: Replication initiation
physiology.replication_initiation.how: Per-cell time since birth of the first oriC step-up (a new round fires). Absent for cells born between rounds that don't re-initiate in-cycle. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.replication_completion.label: Replication completion
physiology.replication_completion.how: Per-cell time since birth when replication forks first clear (a round terminates). NOTE: under overlapping rounds this tracks a DIFFERENT round than initiation above — they are not one round's start/end. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

composition.protein_fraction.label: Protein / dry weight
composition.protein_fraction.how: Time-mean protein mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::PopulationPhenotypeBasalCard.

composition.rna_fraction.label: Total RNA / dry weight
composition.rna_fraction.how: Time-mean total-RNA (rRna+tRna+mRna) mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::PopulationPhenotypeBasalCard.

composition.dna_fraction.label: DNA / dry weight
composition.dna_fraction.how: Time-mean DNA mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::PopulationPhenotypeBasalCard.

ribosomes.total.label: Total ribosomes
ribosomes.total.how: Time-mean total ribosomes = active (translating) + min(free 30S, 50S). Active is a clean listener; inactive subunits are pulled from the bulk arrays by molecule id. ~20k is the canonical E. coli content. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

ribosomes.active_fraction.label: Active fraction
ribosomes.active_fraction.how: Fraction of ribosomes actively translating (active / total) — the translating-vs-idle reading of ribosome usage. ~0.8 at balanced growth. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

ribosomes.elongation_rate.label: Elongation rate
ribosomes.elongation_rate.how: Time-mean effective peptide elongation rate per ribosome — the efficiency reading of ribosome usage. ~15-20 aa/s in E. coli. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

ribosomes.production.label: Ribosome production (rRNA init)
ribosomes.production.how: Time-mean total rRNA operons initiated per timestep — a ribosome-biogenesis-rate proxy (ribosome_data__did_initialize isn't emitted). Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

omics.transcriptome.label: Transcriptome (mRNA cistron counts)
omics.transcriptome.how: Cell-level ensemble-mean count vector (time-mean within cell over gens≥3, then mean across cells). Graded by log-log R² vs the pinned blessed vector — self-pin => R²=1; a reformulation (e.g. PDMP) is the first run that moves it. Source: v2ecoli/library/card_vectors.py::extract_vectors.

omics.proteome.label: Proteome (monomer counts)
omics.proteome.how: Cell-level ensemble-mean count vector (time-mean within cell over gens≥3, then mean across cells). Graded by log-log R² vs the pinned blessed vector — self-pin => R²=1; a reformulation (e.g. PDMP) is the first run that moves it. Source: v2ecoli/library/card_vectors.py::extract_vectors.

fluxes.exchange.label: Exchange-flux fingerprint
fluxes.exchange.how: All 87 external exchange fluxes (ensemble-mean) vs the pinned reference. A flux that appears (0→active) or disappears (active→0) is a qualitative regression = mismatch, flagged on the plot. Cell-level mean exchange flux (negative = uptake, positive = secretion). Time-mean within cell over gens≥3, then per-cell values across the ensemble. Order = sorted(sim_data.external_state.all_external_exchange_molecules) = the FBA emit order. Source: v2ecoli/library/card_vectors.py::extract_vectors.
